---
title: "Documentation"
---

This website is made with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) from the `docs` folder, and published to [ribasim.nl](https://ribasim.nl/) from `main` by the workflow `.github/workflows/docs.yml`.

```sh
pixi run docs         # preview, with the viewer and the API reference
pixi run docs-render  # render as on CI
```

Quarto silently finds no pages if the repository is below a hidden folder, such as a worktree in `.claude/worktrees`. Render a copy elsewhere in that case.

## Diagrams

Use [Mermaid](https://mermaid.js.org/) for diagrams of steps and flows, in a `{mermaid}` code block, with short labels.
The theme is set in `docs/_quarto.yml`.
`pixi run dvc-dag` makes the full graph of the pipeline in `docs/dev/_dvc-dag.mmd`.

## Figures

CI has no access to the data, so the maps and charts of real examples are committed as small PNGs in `docs/figures`, with the script that made them, `scripts/docs_figures.py`.
They show a state of the model, and do not change by themselves.
Remake them when a change makes them wrong, after pulling the data they read.
Stages that are not yet in `dvc.lock` have to run first, by their scripts.
The figures are not stages in DVC, because any change to the `ribasim_nl` package would otherwise mark them as changed.

```sh
pixi run docs-figures              # all figures
pixi run docs-figures lumping      # one group
```

| Group | Pull first |
|:------|:-----------|
| `national`, `seasonal`, `forcing`, `authorities` | `run_lhm_coupled` |
| `main_water_system` | `hws_transient`, `data/Basisgegevens/RWS_waterschaps_grenzen/waterschap.gpkg` |
| `coupling` | `samenvoegen`, `run_lhm_coupled` |
| `lumping` | `parameterized_drents_overijsselse_delta --with-deps`, and run its `01_fix_model.py`, whose model is not an output of DVC |
| `level_controlled` | `postprocessed_delfland`, `crossings@delfland`, `shortest_paths@delfland`, `boezemmodel@delfland`, `forcing_delfland` |
| `profiles` | `profiles_delfland` |

Keep each figure below 700 kB, the limit of the Git hooks, by using flat colours; `save` reduces the palette of the PNG.

## API reference

[quartodoc](https://machow.github.io/quartodoc/) builds the [API reference](../reference/index.qmd) from the docstrings, in the sections of `docs/_quarto.yml`.
